title: Modern Web Developer Portfolio: Best Practices, Case Studies & Resume Integration
transcript:
The 5 essential sections of any high-converting portfolio:
Section 1: Hero. Name, title, 1-line elevator pitch, and two buttons: 'View My Work' (scrolls to projects) and 'Get In Touch' (opens email/contact).
Section 2: Featured Projects (The Core). 3 to 4 best projects with badges for the tech stack, a 2-sentence summary, a link to the live demo, and a link to the source code.
Section 3: Skills & Tools. Grouped logically: Frontend, Backend, 3D/Design, DevOps.
Section 4: About Me & Experience. A short personal story explaining how you got into coding/design, your career trajectory, and a downloadable PDF resume button.
Section 5: Footer & Contact CTA. A clear call to action: 'Have a project in mind? Let's build something together.' with email and links to LinkedIn, GitHub, and Twitter/X.
